extract: crawl mode follows linked pages

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, CrawlConfig, ExtractionConfig, UrlExtractionConfig, ExtractInputKind, UrlExtractionMode

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com")
    config = ExtractionConfig(url=UrlExtractionConfig(crawl=CrawlConfig(max_depth=1, max_pages=4, respect_robots_txt=False), mode=UrlExtractionMode("crawl")))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.summary.pages_crawled)
    print(result.results[1].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
